pages.title: Instant Hydration
pages.text: World rainfall and groundwater use 0~500, while cultivated plants read 0~100% hydration. Current seasonal rainfall becomes instant hydration, with nearby water adding a bonus.

pages.title: Wild and Farmland
pages.text: Wild generation uses long-term average climate; farmland tooltips show average and current hydration separately. See $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)TFC Rainfall$() and $(l:mechanics/hydration)Hydration$().
